verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own docs show a partial opt-out mechanism (a 'Usage Data' toggle for non-personal data, and diagnostic logs that are only sent when the user manually clicks 'Send feedback'), but the same docs describe mandatory, non-optional location sharing every hour for conditional-access compliance, and an independent Exodus Privacy analysis cited in the community thread reports the app 'tracks your position all the time' — directly contradicting the idea that a user can fully opt out of tracking. missing for 10: a documented master telemetry/location opt-out, first-party privacy dashboard showing what's collected, and independent confirmation that toggling 'Usage Data' off actually stops all tracking.
